sample.reason: The sampling control was below the visible viewport when Pakomo was started. Page repositioning occurred during the authorized window; when the elapsed-time check showed the limit had passed, the sample button was not pressed.

recovery.source: ADB dumpsys connectivity; current NetworkAgentInfo listing contained connected Wi-Fi and no VPN network-agent entry

processReview.failureCause: The sampling page was not positioned at the trigger before the time-limited VPN run began.
processReview.correctiveSequenceForAnyFutureSeparately: Position and verify the sample button first, then start Pakomo, verify forwarding, start the sample immediately, and stop Pakomo before the 60-second limit.
